Innocent children and their families were murdered by your weapons!|Alexandra Winger and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Brandei|<ref name="Shades of Gray">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/fiction/shadesofgray/index.html|text=Shades of Gray: from the Adventures of Alex Winger}}</ref>}}
The '''Raid on Janara III''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack on [[Janara III]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

==The raid==
{{Quote|My father was one of the Emperor's High Inquisitors,the Jedi executioners who were more ruthless observers of His Imperial Will. He must have been looking for you and others like you. A thousand or more lives to find one little girl and a handful of Jedi hopefuls.|[[Jaalib Brandl]]|<ref name="Betrayal by Knight">{{JournalCite|12|Betrayal by Knight}}</ref>}}
[[File:Adalric.jpg|thumb|left|200px|High Inquisitor Adalric Cessius Brandl.]]

In [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], [[High Inquisitor]] [[Adalric Cessius Brandl]] was part of an Imperial armada sent to destroy a town on [[Janara III]] that was reported to be a hive of Rebel activity that harbored [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-in-hiding. With Brandl leading the task force that included the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']], the city of [[Sreina]] was completely destroyed, and thousands of innocent civilians massacred.

However Brandl did not realize that a young [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] child survived the assault.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We found her, barely alive, in the rubble of a house after a raid. Damn Rebels. The medics assure us she will recover. But the child has no family, Sali. They were killed in the raid.|Senior Lieutenant Brandei, to [[Sali Winger]]|<ref name="Turning Point">{{JournalCite|5|Turning Point (Charlene Newcomb)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Dair_and_Alex_6yo.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Alexandra Winger shortly after her adoption.]]

Sifting through the rubble of one homestead, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Chanceller]], a young officer, pulled a small unconscious six year old girl out of the wreckage; [[Alexandra Winger|Alexandra]]. Chanceller's superior, [[Senior Lieutenant/Legends|Senior Lieutenant]] [[Brandei]], who had not known of Brandl's true orders, chose to take the child to be adopted by [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]] [[Tork Winger]] of [[Garos IV]].
